entries.title: SUCCESSOR closure-2 · lineage matrix, EASY: the word that withholds each run, the reports in force and the history reference, by the runtime and by the oracle
entries.contract: F1 (this mission): a row the record holds is never refused again because a later review's report is read before it
entries.before: scenario '21 a symptom stop in the app's report, the import says done (conflict), then the import re-syncs' expected, for EASY only, the reports in force ['app-stop','dev-x','dev-x-v2'] and no history reference (LONG: ['app-stop','dev-x-v2'] and 'whole'). On EASY the athlete's stop and the carried device report have no report time and tie at the end of the run's day; FREEZE-4 read the stop first by event id ('app-stop' < 'dev-x'), refused the carried device report (DUPLICATE_CONFLICT_QUARANTINED) and dropped it from the record (an F1 loss), so the device re-sync found nothing to correct (INVALID_CORRECTION_CHAIN)
entries.after: the record is rebuilt before the review's reports are read: the device report stays in force, flagged conflicted, the stop is refused as the conflict, and the re-sync then resolves the conflict (it corrects the device's own report). EASY now reads as LONG always did: in force ['app-stop','dev-x-v2'], history reference 'whole'. The withholding word, the oracle written outside the runtime, the easy band and the calibration assertions of the matrix are unchanged and pass
entries.sporting: the session's weekly status goes CONFLICTED -> COMPLETED on EASY, and the re-synced device measurement becomes the run's history reference, a distance the athlete's refused symptom-stop report disputes, as LONG already read (SSCTR C-NCC-2; mechanism SSCTR-NCC-01, routed to the conflict-policy mission). The easy band, the calibration and the next long run are unchanged (assertion 4 of the matrix), and the run stays withheld from pace readers
entries.safety: the athlete's stop is still heard by its format record (in force by the reader as before); the device report is no longer silently lost
entries.successor: v1core-ncc-normalization-consistency.test.mjs: 'successor of v1core-successor-lineage.test.mjs:205 (F1, scenario 21, EASY)', which runs the frozen file's whole SUCCESSOR closure-2 matrix (both families) from a temporary copy whose only change is that one EASY expectation, now LONG's
